words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round with 1 audience to add uuids.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 110 (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
Wait until the round has closed (bid end and extra closing time over).
The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present; Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Trade Request not found”, and never with a server error.
